🪔 DIWALI AFTER DARK

Bollywood Party with DJ Browny | 20 Stories High 🌃📍 230 FIFTH Rooftop — Empire Room, NYC
✨ This Diwali, take the celebration to new heights! ✨
Get ready for DIWALI AFTER DARK, the ultimate Bollywood Diwali party, 20 stories above Manhattan! Celebrate the festival of lights with breathtaking NYC skyline views, electrifying Bollywood beats, disco classics, and an unforgettable night of music, dancing, and festive glamour.
🎧 FEATURING DJ BROWNY
One of the finest Desi DJs in the USA, DJ Browny is bringing the heat with Bollywood bangers, ’70s disco classics, desi remixes, and dancefloor anthems that'll keep you moving all night long.
🌆 20 STORIES HIGH. ONE EPIC NIGHT.
Experience the magic of Diwali against the iconic Manhattan skyline, with the Empire State Building lighting up the backdrop. From candlelit rooftop vibes to a high-energy Bollywood dance floor, this is where tradition meets nightlife.
